segments.translation: It’s not the full words.

segments.speaker: jerry-cochran
segments.text: ᎠᏯ ᏱᎩᏪᏍᏓ ᏍᎩᏅ ᏓᏅᏕᏲᎲᏍᎦ ᏭᎪᏛ
segments.translation: If I were to say, they need to teach more.

segments.speaker: guy-soldier
segments.text: ᏄᏓᎴ ᏛᎭ ᎤᏃᏴᎦ ᏝᎨ?
segments.translation: It sounds different, doesn’t it?

segments.speaker: jerry-cochran
segments.text: ᎥᎥ, ᏲᏍᎩᎾ ᏢᎮᏂ ᏱᎬᏴᏢᏲᎵᎦ ᎠᏎᎮᎾ ᎠᏁᏟᏙᏗ
segments.translation: Yes, but you can’t give up, you must keep trying.

segments.speaker: guy-soldier
segments.text: ᎠᏎᏛ
segments.translation: Have to.

segments.speaker: jerry-cochran
segments.text: ᎬᏂᏗᏍᏗ ᎢᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎮᏍᏗ ᎮᏂ ᏯᏬᎯᏳ ᎤᎵᏒᎲᏍᏗ ᏰᎩᏰᎸᎾᏁᎳ ᎠᏯ ᏥᏕᎩᏅᏍᎬᏢᏁ ᏣᎳᎩ
segments.translation: To keep our language alive. I don’t believe the Cherokee that was put in our mouths was meant to fade away.

segments.speaker: guy-soldier
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎪ ᎯᎾ Chief ᏥᎩᎧᎯ ᏣᏁᎵᏗ ᎤᏍᎪᎸᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᏂ
segments.translation: That’s what I’m happy about—that the Chief we have is trying to keep the language from fading away.

segments.speaker: jerry-cochran
segments.text: ᏙᏛᎭ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎩᏓ ᎥᎾᏓᏁᎳ ᎠᎭᏂ
segments.translation: Yeah, this is quite an amazing building they have here.

segments.speaker: guy-soldier
segments.text: ᏍᎩᎾ ᎢᎦ ᎢᎦᎵᎡᎵᎪ ᎠᏯ
segments.translation: That’s what I’m happy about, too.

segments.speaker: henry-sawney
segments.text: ᎠᏣᎳᎩᏍ Ᏺ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎯᎢ Chief ᏣᏯᎠ?
segments.translation: Is the Chief we have a speaker?

segments.speaker: jerry-cochran
segments.text: ᎲᎥ
segments.translation: No.

segments.speaker: henry-sawney
segments.text: ᏢᎩ
segments.translation: Really?

segments.speaker: guy-soldier
segments.text: no, ᏍᎩᏅ ᏳᏍᏓ ᎤᏛᎦ ᎮᏂ ᎤᏩ ᎠᏗᏍᎪ ᎴᏱᎩ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏓ ᎠᏴᏟᏢ Chief ᎡᏧᎳ ᏲᏁᎦ ᎠᏣᎳᎩ ᏗᎦᏬᏂᏍᎦ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏴᏟᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᏚᎦ ᎤᏮ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎯᎢ ᏥᏂᏓᏛᏁ ᏥᎾᏅᏛᏁᏕ
segments.translation: No, but he said he looks forward to the day when we have a chief that can speak both Cherokee and English. That’s why we’re here doing this.

segments.speaker: jerry-cochran
segments.text: ᎩᎶᏛᎭ Ꮩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎬᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏃᎴ ᏲᏁᎦ ᎬᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏳᏙᎩᏯ ᏢᎾ ᏱᎦᏰᏗᏍᏕᎳ ᎾᎮᏂ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎪᏓ ᎠᏕᎳ ᎤᏩᏟᏌᏅ ᏍᎩᎮᏂ ᏏᏆ ᏱᏙᏧᏒᏂᏛᎾ ᎥᎾᎮᏂ ᏳᏫᏗᎶ
segments.translation: If somebody who could talk fully in English and in Cherokee ran for Chief, we wouldn’t help them. But if they gathered up a lot of money and had a big hog fry, we would go there.

segments.speaker: mitch-holcomb
segments.text: ᏙᎮᏂ ᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏓ
segments.translation: Truly, that’s how it is.

segments.speaker: guy-soldier
segments.text: ᏏᏆᏭ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᏰᎩᏩ
segments.translation: They would use a pig to buy us.

segments.speaker: jerry-cochran
segments.text: Joe Bird ᏛᎮ ᎤᏩᏌ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎤᏴᏟ ᎾᏅ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏓᎴᏁ Hasting Shade ᏧᏴᏢ ᏝᎦ. ᎤᏬᏟᏗ ᏥᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎸ Hastings ᎨᏓ ᎠᎩᎷᏨ ᎭᏯᏩᏘ ᎥᎾ ᏱᏛᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏛᏯᎢᏒ ᎣᎩᎾᎳᏍᎬᎸᏓ softball. Boy Deputy Chief ᏫᏥᏢᎥᎦ ᎤᏛᏅ. ᏙᏍ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ, ᎥᎥ. ᏙᎲ ᏛᏛᏁᎵ ᏙᎰᏓᎩᏴ? ᏗᏯᏩᏅᏔ ᏧᏛᏅ. ᏫᏚᏓᎩᏴᎾᏏ. ᏍᎩᎮᏂ ᏍᏊ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏓ ᏗᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᎲ
segments.translation: Joe Bird was the only Cherokee speaker who was in office. Hastings Shade was his deputy for a little while. I thought this was funny: One time, when I was working at Hastings Hospital, he was coming toward me just after we got through playing ball. And he said, “I applied for deputy chief.” And I said, “Really? What are you going to do if you win?” “I don’t know,” he said. And he won. And he also made gigs.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏙᎮᏲ ᏚᏳᎦᏛᏮ ᏣᏃᏎᎴᏲ Ꮂ ᏱᏣᎵᏍᎪᏁᎴ
segments.translation: I guess he told you the truth, he didn’t lie to you.

segments.speaker: jerry-cochran
segments.text: yeah, ᏲᏩᏕ ᏴᏩ ᎯᎢ ᏂᏓᎬᏕᏁᎳ ᏯᏗ. ᎠᏎᎾ ᎯᎡᏲ ᏚᏳᎦᏓ ᎤᏃᎮᏞ ᏢᎮᏂ ᏳᎾᏕ
segments.translation: Yeah, they really will fill you up when he says, “This is what I’m going to do.” He told the truth—he really didn’t know what he was going to do.

segments.speaker: guy-soldier
segments.text: ᎠᏎᎾ ᏚᏳᎦᏛᏍᏊ ᎤᏃᎮᏞ ᏢᏅ ᏃᏒᎾ ᏱᏄᏪᏌ ᎠᏙᎩᏯᏍᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏓ. ᎢᎦᏗ ᎮᏂ Ꮲ ᏚᏳᎦᏓ ᏯᏂᏃᎮᏍᎪ ᎠᎾᏙᎩᏯᏍᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏓ. ᎯᏅ Ꮩ ᏚᏳᎦᏛ ᎤᏃᎮᏞ
segments.translation: But some people won’t tell you the truth when they’re running for the office. They’ll just tell you what you want to hear, while they are running for the office.

segments.speaker: jerry-cochran
segments.text: ᏣᏛᎪᏗᏮᏛ ᏣᏚᎵᎲ ᏂᏛᏂᏪᏌ
segments.translation: They’re just going to tell you what they want you to hear.

segments.speaker: guy-soldier
segments.text: yeah, ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ, ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᏥᏕᏓᏝᏃᎲᎳ
segments.translation: Yeah. I’m happy. I’m happy we had this talk.

segments.speaker: henry-sawney
segments.translation: Yeah!

segments.speaker: jerry-cochran
segments.text: ᎠᏬᎯᏳᏒᏃ ᏘᏓᏪᏙᏂᏒ
segments.translation: I thought you were going to kiss him.

segments.speaker: guy-soldier
segments.text: ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ ᏙᏓᏓᎪᎲᎢ
segments.translation: I’m grateful, until we meet again.
